_meta.protocol: primary rungs: e7_wasserstein.fit_field, 6x6 log grid + Nelder-Mead maxfev 40 at dt_fit=1, production re-eval dt=0.5; fixed knobs via extra_cfg passthrough (NOT fitted); A=10 kc_grid=logspace(-2.5,-0.5,6); constrained fallback ('_c' rungs, only for rungs whose unconstrained optimum is inadmissible): same grid + NM protocol at dt=0.5 on W1 + admissibility penalty (PEN_DS=50 veh km per veh/km of max downstream s above 1, PEN_STUCK=50 per 0.01 of stuck fraction above 0.01); RDR/RLL = out/e8/final_config.json kappas re-evaluated, NOT refit

R0.description: cap 2000 + w_s=0.6w (no DR, no LL: the leaky reference)

R1.description: cap + w_s + eta_la=200 m (the general fix)

R4.description: cap + eta_la=200 m, NO w_s (is w_s still needed?)

RLL.description: cap + w_s=0.6w + eta_la=200 m, E8 final kappas re-evaluated (NOT refit; the like-for-like DR->LL swap; reference only, never a pick)

RDR.description: cap + w_s=0.6w + downstream_release, E8 final kappas re-evaluated (NOT refit; reference only, never a pick)

_meta.downstream_release_policy: used ONLY in the RDR reference row; every R-rung is state-only (eta_la)
_meta.pick_rule: admissible = ds_stuck(t=700) <= 0.01 AND max downstream s <= 1 veh/km (all snapshots, data cells fully inside the DR zone); candidates = primary R-rungs + constrained refits, excluding degenerate ones (N_s(700) < 1 veh: no stuck population, i.e. not a catch & release model); among admissible candidates pick min W1 at dt=0.5 (q2500); RDR/RLL are reference only; if none is admissible pick=None and figures/transfer use the min-W1 rung, flagged
_meta.verdict_rule: reproduces_kludge = admissible AND |W1 rel diff| <= 5% AND |wake diff| <= 3 veh/km vs RDR

diagnostics.e8: wake, ds_stuck, waviness, wedge, rarefaction, s_layer, ds_max_s: e8_ladder.eval_rung (imported); definitions in out/e8/ladder.json _meta
diagnostics.startup_wave:
Head recession of the {s > s_min} region relative to the CAV after
    t_fast (primary, flattened at the top level), plus the half-maximum
    head (cells with s > SUW_HALF max_x s, t18 convention). Linear-fit kinematics of a head position over t_win.

    head_of(s_row [veh/km]) -> index of the head cell or None.  Returns
    the head's absolute speed, the CAV speed, v_recede_cav = v_cav -
    v_head, the s-class FD speed at the head's total density (c_s = v_f
    after t_fast: min{v_f, c_wave (P/rho - 1)}) and v_recede_platoon =
    v_s_fd - v_head.
diagnostics.ll_budget:
Integrate mu_ll s dx over the saved states in t_win (10 s cadence,
    an estimate) split by position relative to the CAV cell
    j_cav = int(x_cav // dx): strictly downstream (j > j_cav), the CAV
    cell, the BUDGET_NEAR_CELLS cells upstream of it, and the far upstream
    queue body.  Also the kappa_r release integrated over j <= j_cav for
    the same states, so in-queue LL release can be compared to the
    modelled overtaking release.
diagnostics.downstream_rates:
Linearized downstream growth rate of leaked s at the background
    state (lf form, ell = s, a = 0; E8 analytic check):
    lambda = Delta v (kappa_c rho_bg - kappa_r (P - rho_bg)), rho_bg =
    q_in / v_f, Delta v = v_f - u_xi, vs the leader-loss rate
    c_wave / ell_eff.  net = lambda - ll_rate < 0: leaked s decays.
diagnostics.queue: N_s at t=700 s and at t_end [veh] (regrid_sim N_s)

RDR.description: cap + w_s=0.6w + downstream_release, E8 final kappas re-evaluated (NOT refit; reference only, never a pick)

startup_wave.definition: x_head = center of the downstream-most data cell with s > s_min; v_recede_cav = slope of (x_cav - x_head) over t_win; v_s_head_fd = min{v_f, c_wave (P/rho_head - 1)} (s-class FD after t_fast); v_recede_platoon = v_s_head_fd - v_head_abs; half_max repeats it for the head of {s > 0.5 max_x s}

mass.definition: v = -(dN_s/dt) / mean_t max_x s over t_win: front speed of the equivalent sharp-edged platoon of density max_x s (telescoping identity, t18); exactly 0 when nothing releases after t_fast (R0: no mechanism, Delta v = 0).  RDR is small but NOT 0: after t_fast its s-platoon rides at v_f > v_cav_free, overtakes the CAV and is converted by the DR projection -- the kludge acting, not a release wave.  released_frac = 1 - N_s(end)/N_s(start) over t_win

R1_c.statement: R1_c vs RDR: W1 154.6 vs 152.2 (+1.6%), wake 52.7 vs 53.8 veh/km (data 58.6), omega err -2.5% vs -2.5%, e_s +7.0% vs +4.7%; downstream: stuck 0.0015 (RDR 0.0000), max s 1.00 veh/km (RDR 0.00) -> ADMISSIBLE; start-up wave: mass-equivalent front speed 3.61 m/s, 20% of the queue released over [760,900] s (RDR 1.02 m/s, 6%: the DR projection eating s that overtakes the CAV after t_fast, not a release wave); {s>1} head recedes at -0.29 m/s rel. to the CAV vs RDR 0.10; c_wave 3.73, w 6.21; post-release rarefaction growth -400 m vs RDR +300 m (data +1200 m); LL release budget (slow window): 96% inside the queue body, 4% downstream of the CAV cell; in-queue LL release = 28.3x the kappa_r release => the general LL term REPRODUCES the kludge (clean downstream, W1 within 5%, wake within 3 veh/km)

RLL.statement: RLL vs RDR: W1 163.3 vs 152.2 (+7.3%), wake 61.4 vs 53.8 veh/km (data 58.6), omega err -2.5% vs -2.5%, e_s +4.1% vs +4.7%; downstream: stuck 0.0006 (RDR 0.0000), max s 0.55 veh/km (RDR 0.00) -> ADMISSIBLE; start-up wave: mass-equivalent front speed 3.61 m/s, 30% of the queue released over [760,900] s (RDR 1.02 m/s, 6%: the DR projection eating s that overtakes the CAV after t_fast, not a release wave); {s>1} head recedes at 7.57 m/s rel. to the CAV vs RDR 0.10; c_wave 3.73, w 6.21; post-release rarefaction growth +900 m vs RDR +300 m (data +1200 m); LL release budget (slow window): 97% inside the queue body, 3% downstream of the CAV cell; in-queue LL release = 1.5x the kappa_r release => the general LL term does NOT reproduce the kludge on W1, wake density

startup_wave.definition: x_head = center of the downstream-most data cell with s > s_min; v_recede_cav = slope of (x_cav - x_head) over t_win; v_s_head_fd = min{v_f, c_wave (P/rho_head - 1)} (s-class FD after t_fast); v_recede_platoon = v_s_head_fd - v_head_abs; half_max repeats it for the head of {s > 0.5 max_x s}

mass.definition: v = -(dN_s/dt) / mean_t max_x s over t_win: front speed of the equivalent sharp-edged platoon of density max_x s (telescoping identity, t18); exactly 0 when nothing releases after t_fast (R0: no mechanism, Delta v = 0).  RDR is small but NOT 0: after t_fast its s-platoon rides at v_f > v_cav_free, overtakes the CAV and is converted by the DR projection -- the kludge acting, not a release wave.  released_frac = 1 - N_s(end)/N_s(start) over t_win

ll_budget.definition: mu_ll s dx per saved state in t_win, summed; 'in_queue' = cav_cell + upstream_near + upstream_far (j <= j_cav); mean rates are s-weighted per-capita [1/s] over the same cells

startup_wave.definition: x_head = center of the downstream-most data cell with s > s_min; v_recede_cav = slope of (x_cav - x_head) over t_win; v_s_head_fd = min{v_f, c_wave (P/rho_head - 1)} (s-class FD after t_fast); v_recede_platoon = v_s_head_fd - v_head_abs; half_max repeats it for the head of {s > 0.5 max_x s}

mass.definition: v = -(dN_s/dt) / mean_t max_x s over t_win: front speed of the equivalent sharp-edged platoon of density max_x s (telescoping identity, t18); exactly 0 when nothing releases after t_fast (R0: no mechanism, Delta v = 0).  RDR is small but NOT 0: after t_fast its s-platoon rides at v_f > v_cav_free, overtakes the CAV and is converted by the DR projection -- the kludge acting, not a release wave.  released_frac = 1 - N_s(end)/N_s(start) over t_win

queue.degenerate_rule: N_s(700) < 1 veh: no stuck population at all (not a catch & release model)
